The main purpose of this study was to examine how the internet is been utilize by the undergraduates of University Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS). This study employed a descriptive survey approach to examine the relationship between independent variable (selected sociodemographic characteristics and associated factors - relative advantage, compatibility, complexity, importance and interactivity) and the dependent variable (utilization of the internet). The research instrument used was a questionnaire to collect data from 164 second, third, and fourth year undergraduates from all faculties through the stratified random sampling technique.
